name: FireRed Diorama (3D)
description: Turns the overworld into a depth-buffered 3D diorama: metatiles extrude into geometry from their collision bytes, the characters are re-projected onto it, and the ladder picks the map scope (Pallet Town, then Route 1, then everywhere). Presentational only: no collision, movement, trigger or script changes, and every rung falls back to the flat 2D field when the 3D pass cannot start.
